operations.what: RMSNorm per last-dimension row (x / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) * (offset + weight)), with a residual added in place first in the residual's dtype and the stored sum normalized, a weight per group of rows (heads or residual streams), a chosen output dtype; the L2 norm (x / sqrt(sum(x^2) + eps))
operations.verify: on the target against the FP64 rows: FP32 out within 2e-5 absolute plus 2e-5 relative, 16-bit out within one output rounding (plus 1% of a step of the largest value); with a residual, the stored sum within the residual dtype's rounding
operations.invariance: a row's bits independent of the rows beside it and of the row count, the same on a repeat

operations.verify: on the target against the FP64 rows: FP32 out within 2e-5 absolute plus 2e-5 relative, 16-bit out within one output rounding; the queries and keys in one launch equal to the separate calls bit for bit

operations.verify: on the target against the FP64 rows: FP32 out within 2e-5 absolute plus 2e-5 relative, 16-bit out within one output rounding; the fused add and norm equal to the separate calls bit for bit
